termsOfUse.subtitle: Terms of Use and License Agreement
termsOfUse.intro: Welcome to agrodeo. By downloading, installing, or using our application, you agree to these Terms of Use ("Terms"). If you do not agree, do not use the application.
termsOfUse.section1Content: agrodeo is a livestock management application that allows you to record animals, reproductive activities, weighings, finances, pens, and more. The service is offered through free and paid subscription plans.
section2Items: agrodeo offers auto-renewable subscription plans (monthly or annual). This is an auto-renewable subscription.
By subscribing, you authorize recurring charges to the payment method associated with your Apple App Store or Google Play Store account.
Subscription duration is monthly or annual, depending on the selected plan. Price varies by plan and region.
The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.
section3Items: Payments are processed through Apple App Store (iOS) or Google Play Store (Android), depending on your platform.
On the web version, payments are processed through Paddle, our authorized payment provider.
agrodeo does not store credit card information or payment data directly.
Prices include applicable taxes based on your jurisdiction.
section4Items: iOS: You can cancel your subscription from Settings → [Your name] → Subscriptions on your Apple device.
Android: You can cancel from Google Play Store → Subscriptions.
Web: You can manage your subscription through the Paddle customer portal.
Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. You will continue to have access to premium features until the paid period ends.
Uninstalling the application does not cancel your subscription.
section5Items: Refunds for purchases made through Apple App Store are managed exclusively by Apple.
Refunds for purchases on Google Play are managed by Google.
We do not offer direct refunds for subscriptions purchased through app stores.
section6Items: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and password.
Information entered in the application (animal data, finances, etc.) is your responsibility.
You must not use the application for illegal activities or activities that violate third-party rights.
You must provide truthful and up-to-date information when registering.
termsOfUse.section7Content: All intellectual property rights of agrodeo, including but not limited to design, source code, logos, trademarks, text, and images, are the exclusive property of agrodeo and are protected by applicable intellectual property laws. No rights are granted beyond personal use of the application.
section8Items: agrodeo is provided "as is" and "as available."
We do not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted, error-free, or completely secure.
agrodeo is not responsible for data loss, direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of the application.
Livestock decisions made based on information from the application are the sole responsibility of the user.
termsOfUse.section9Content: The use of your personal data is governed by our Privacy Policy. By using agrodeo, you agree to the collection and use of data as described in that policy.
section10Items: You may request the deletion of your account at any time by contacting us by email.
We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms.
Upon termination of your account, you will lose access to all data stored in the application.
termsOfUse.section11Content: We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time. Changes will be notified through the application or by email. Continued use of agrodeo after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
termsOfUse.section12Content: If you accessed agrodeo through the Apple App Store, the Apple Standard End User License Agreement (EULA) also applies.

privacyPolicy.subtitle: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: At agrodeo, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information when you use our application.
section1Sub2Items: Animal records (tag, breed, weight, reproductive status, etc.)
Activities and events (weighings, inseminations, calvings, vaccinations)
section1Sub3Items: Usage and navigation data within the app
privacyPolicy.section2Content: Your data is stored securely on cloud servers provided by Supabase, a database platform that meets industry security standards. Data is transmitted through encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
section3Items: Row-level security policies (RLS) to isolate data between users
Restricted data access only to authorized users
privacyPolicy.section4Intro: We use the following third-party services:
section4Items: Apple App Store / Google Play Store: Payment processing for mobile applications
Paddle: Payment processing for the web version
privacyPolicy.section4Outro: Each service has its own privacy policy. We recommend reviewing them to understand how they handle your data.
section5Items: Provide and improve the agrodeo service
Generate reports and statistics about your livestock
Send relevant notifications about your account
privacyPolicy.section5Outro: We do not sell or share your personal or livestock data with third parties for advertising purposes.
section6Items: Access all your data stored in the application
Delete your account and all associated data
Request a copy of your personal data
privacyPolicy.section6Outro: To exercise these rights, contact us at faustosicilia123@gmail.com.
privacyPolicy.section7Intro: agrodeo uses browser and device local storage to:
section7Items: Save subscription status for offline access
privacyPolicy.section7Outro: We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.
privacyPolicy.section8Content: agrodeo is not intended for children under 13 years of age. We do not intentionally collect information from children under 13. If we discover that we have collected data from a minor, we will delete it immediately. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with information, contact us.
privacyPolicy.section9Content: We retain your data as long as your account is active. If you request account deletion, we will delete your personal and livestock data within 30 days, unless there is a legal obligation to retain it.
privacyPolicy.section10Content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes through the application or by email. The last update date is indicated at the beginning of this document.
privacyPolicy.section11Content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at:
